product_one_liner.value: Fluxco is a transformer procurement marketplace for utilities, data centers, developers, EPCs, and other power-infrastructure buyers that turns specifications into competitive bids from a global OEM network and manages delivery, service, and warranty.

pricing_page.notes: The site routes visitors to a quote/contact form and does not expose a pricing page or prices.

named_customers.notes: Only one customer name was publicly identified; the company site does not show a customer/case-study roster.

eng_blog.notes: The readable index is a marketing/resource library of buyer guides, technical explainers, and industry insights; it does not show an engineering blog with two build/architecture posts by engineers.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation/footer exposes the marketplace, resources, careers, privacy, terms, and quote/contact paths, but no docs, help center, or developer portal.

model_provider.notes: No public product model/provider statement was found in the reviewed product, resources, privacy, terms, or careers material.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy/legal material reviewed does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a certification.

launched_6mo.notes: The founder announced Fluxco launching on 2026-07-23, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman’s profile lists Founder and CEO at Fluxco beginning January 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable job posts mention keeping the CRM clean but name no CRM or sales/marketing platform; the engineering post names application infrastructure rather than a CRM.
